import json
def slotcolors():
    out={}
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:

            out[(r0,c0)]=n['color']
    return out
def marker():
    a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    m1=[a[r][c] for r,c in ((25,34),(25,37),(28,34),(28,37))]
    m2=[a[r][c] for r,c in ((34,34),(34,37),(37,34),(37,37))]
    return ''.join(m1), ''.join(m2)
def check(tag):
    res=last_action_result
    done=res.get('level_completed') or res.get('done') or res.get('game_over') or res.get('run_complete')
    print(tag, slotcolors(), marker(), {k:res.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','level_completed','done','game_over')})
    return done

        break
